name: cards-demo-2

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows the hovered card with the skyline dimmed and the white text clearest.

tagline: A blog card with an author row over a dim night-skyline photo.
summary: A tall editorial card with a night city skyline behind an avatar, author name and read time at the top, and a title with a short paragraph at the bottom. Hovering darkens the photo.
appearance: A tall rounded card with a dark photo of a city waterfront at night behind a faint overlay. Top left holds a small round avatar beside "Manu Arora" and "2 min read", with the heading "Author Card" and a short paragraph at the bottom.
behaviour: Hovering deepens a black overlay across the photo so the skyline dims and the white text stands out. Nothing else moves, and leaving restores the lighter image.
demo_content: Author "Manu Arora", "2 min read", heading "Author Card", over a night skyline.
search_phrases: blog post card with author avatar
article card over a city photo
author byline card for a blog
dark image card with read time
editorial card with name and minutes
use_when: A blog or editorial grid needs post cards that pair an author byline with a moody photo.
avoid_when: The copy and avatar are hardcoded, and the only response is a darkening overlay on hover.
customise: Nothing is exposed; the name, read time, heading, paragraph, avatar path and photo URL all live in the file.
weight_why: One image card with a CSS hover overlay and a single remote photo.

a11y.note: The avatar has alt text, but the card has no link or focus state and the hover darkening is unreachable by keyboard.

issues: All copy, the avatar and the photo are hardcoded, so reuse means editing the file.
The only hover response is a darkening overlay; clicking the card does nothing.
The avatar points at a local /manu.png path that will not resolve elsewhere.
polish_why: Tidy type and a readable layout; the hover effect is slight and the card is entirely hardcoded.
